title: Phonological Awareness Tasks for Italian-English Comparison
author: Chiara Valeria Marinelli
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.96kh9cw

steps.title: Administer Spoonerisms Task
steps.instruction: Read 24 pairs of words aloud to the child and ask them to exchange the first sounds of the two words and say the resulting words aloud.

substeps.instruction: Provide the following instruction: 'I’m going to read you words. Listen carefully, as your task is to exchange the first sounds of the words and say aloud the result. Do not think about the way words are spelled, only think of the sounds. I will tell you whether you should obtain new words or made-up words.'
Present 12 pairs that result in real words and 12 pairs that result in non-words.
Score the task: award 1 point for each correct pair and 0.5 points if only one word of the pair is correct.

steps.title: Administer Phoneme Deletion Task
steps.instruction: Provide the child with a spoken bi-syllabic word and a specific phoneme, then ask them to repeat the word without that phoneme.

substeps.instruction: Provide the following instruction: 'I am going to say a word and then one of its sounds. For example, I may say /table/ and then the sound /t/. You should listen carefully and then repeat the word back but without the sound. So if I said /table/ and /t/ you would say /able/. Taking away a sound may result in a real word like in the case of table without /t/ /able’ or in a made up word. For example, /cabbage/ without /c/ is /abbage/ which is not a real word. Do not think about the way the words are spelled, only think of the sounds.'
Conduct 40 trials in a quasi-random order.
Ensure 20 trials result in real words and 20 result in non-words.
Include 5 items for each deletion position (1st through 4th position).
Score 1 point for each correct trial.
